args.command: echo '=== CHATGPT BIN ==='; command -v chatgpt || true; ls -l /usr/bin/chatgpt /usr/local/bin/chatgpt /opt/chatgpt/chatgpt 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== SESSION ==='; ls -l /usr/local/libexec/zen-chatgpt-session.sh 2>/dev/null || true; sed -n '1,160p' /usr/local/libexec/zen-chatgpt-session.sh 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== PROCESSES ==='; pgrep -a -u zenui -f 'chatgpt|chrome|openbox' || true; pgrep -a -f '/usr/lib/xorg/Xorg :0|/usr/bin/Xorg :0' || true; echo '=== UNITS ==='; systemctl list-units 'zen-chatgpt*.service' --all --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl is-active zen-mini-taskbar.service 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Diagnose exact ChatGPT binary/session paths for persistent service
